advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: give people what their want or need you'll become successful if you solve people's problems you'll become wealthy
advice_items.summary_en: Meeting wants and needs brings success, while solving people's problems builds true wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 满足需求能成功，解决问题才能真正致富

guests.first_money_or_break: 从医30年，2006年冒着最大风险独立创办诊所，创业18年来单年最高收入达170万美元。

advice_items.quote: faith without works is dead so you have to have faith and you have to work and together you have success
advice_items.summary_en: Pair unwavering faith with consistent hard work—neither works without the other.
advice_items.summary_zh: 信仰必须与行动结合，两者兼备才能成功

advice_items.quote: you actually can rent where you live and you can rent what you own... make sure it's cash flow is a good investment
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on positive cash flow in real estate and rent business space as a tax write-off instead of blindly buying.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重视现金流而非盲目买楼，确保房产有正向现金流

advice_items.quote: you need to have a personal brand your personal brand drives your business people buy into you and they buy into whatever you sell
advice_items.summary_en: Build a personal brand in any occupation because people buy into you before they buy your product.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无论何种职业都要打造个人品牌，让客户先认可你

advice_items.quote: you cannot give up even if you don't get the ratings you don't get the support you need you got to keep on going
advice_items.summary_en: Keep pushing even without immediate traction or support, because one breakthrough moment can change everything.
advice_items.summary_zh: 即使没有流量和支持也别放弃，坚持下去才有突破

guests.first_money_or_break: 大学毕业时背负15万美元助学贷款，创办数字营销公司12年，单年最高收入达430万美元，同时持有佛罗里达州房产经纪执照。
guests.role_or_title: Digital Marketing Company Owner & Licensed Realtor

advice_items.quote: I probably could have gone broke probably four times in the last 30 years and it just you got to keep finding a way
advice_items.summary_en: Get creative with financing—including customer capital—and relentlessly find a way when near bankruptcy.
advice_items.summary_zh: 濒临破产也要保持韧性，想方设法找资金活下去

advice_items.quote: if you're ever going to talk about something tell me where you're the best at not where you're second best at right nobody cares
advice_items.summary_en: Pitch and position yourself around what you are #1 at—nobody cares about second best.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只主打你做到第一的领域，没人关心第二名

guests.first_money_or_break: 原本打算成为诉讼律师，30年前偶然进入回收行业，四度濒临破产并四处借钱及争取客户出资周转，最终打造出全美第二大回收企业。
guests.role_or_title: Founder & Owner, 2nd Largest US Recycling Company

advice_items.quote: believing that you can is way more profitable than believing that you can't
advice_items.summary_en: Self-belief directly generates far greater returns than self-doubt.
advice_items.summary_zh: 相信自己能成，远比怀疑自己更赚钱

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: stay small enough long enough you'll be big enough soon enough that means keep the expenses low whenever money is high don't be in a rush to actually get the Cullinan and all the jewelry
advice_items.summary_en: Keep overhead low even when revenue rises and wait until you have millions saved before buying luxury cars.
advice_items.summary_zh: 高收入时保持低开销，积累百万后再买豪车

advice_items.quote: scrolling watching other people live their life versus getting it after themselves
advice_items.summary_en: Stop passively scrolling and watching others live their lives; go get after it yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别光刷手机看别人生活，要亲自去拼搏行动

advice_items.quote: we never look down on anybody unless we're willing to help them up
advice_items.summary_en: Stay humble on your way to the top and only look down to lift others up.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持谦卑，若向下看只为拉别人一把

guests.first_money_or_break: 创业14年，前5年陷入困境甚至靠卖血浆凑油钱；因妻子失望的神情和女儿出生深受触动后发力突破，在2020年单年最高赚到1600万美元。
